occurrences.source_segment: In this work, different plant oil-loaded nanoemulsions were prepared to investigate the influence of their particle size, zeta potential and composition on hair treatment efficacy.
occurrences.target_segment: Dans ce travail, différentes nanoémulsions chargées d'huile végétale ont été préparées pour étudier l'influence de leur taille de particules, de leur potentiel zêta et de leur composition sur l'efficacité du traitement capillaire.

occurrences.source_segment: Thus, we suggest that finding the right balance between cationic surfactant and plant oils may be the most appropriate path to develop effective nanoemulsions in hair treatment.
